external_collaboration.evidence_quote: What a fantastic experience to learn about Apple Seeds Teaching Farm in Fayetteville, Arkansas. Our team enjoys pitching in and partnering with the Apple Seeds mission to inspire healthy living using garden-based education. We are pleased to be helping the Apple Seeds team build a grill to prepare for their sold-out annual fundraiser right around the corner, on October 8th.
Föda Studio, located in Austin, Texas, has been designing award-winning projects for 19 years, including The Momentary in Bentonville and now Markham Hill.

Brick Avenue Lofts, a new 252-unit apartment development in Downtown Bentonville, opens this month. From the earliest planning stages, Ryan Hale, founder of Laneshift, has advised the SREG development team on how to make the property more bike friendly and to expand existing bike infrastructure in the city. Connection Quarterly sat down with Ryan to talk about his role in creating Brick Avenue and his work to make cycling more accessible and inclusive.

When invasive plants are removed, native plants often spring up from seeds that have waited for years for the right conditions. Isaac assisted the Northwest Arkansas Land Trust with one such area, the newly opened Wilson Springs Preserve. Before restoration began, a dense understory of honeysuckle was so thick that under it was only mud – no grasses or flowers or young trees. After the honeysuckle was removed, the earth exploded with new life.
